instantiated_cells.justification: Section 101.99 makes specified lobbying violations misdemeanors (fourth- or first-degree), establishing criminal penalties for noncompliance.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled statutes describe penalty classifications (e.g., misdemeanor degrees) but contain no evidence about whether penalties are actually imposed in practice.

The bundled text provides for investigations by the attorney general (e.g., §§101.79, 121.69) but does not require periodic audits of lobbying disclosures; determining any audit requirement would need additional provisions or rules not included.
No information in the bundled statutes indicates the frequency or extent of audits in practice.
